newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: INVESTEC TO MANAGE NAMIBIAN GOVT PENSION PORTFOLIO.
newsitem.headline: INVESTEC TO MANAGE NAMIBIAN GOVT PENSION PORTFOLIO.

text.p: Investec Asset Management announced on Thursday it had been appointed manager of the Namibian Government Institutions Pension Fund's development capital portfolio of more than N$175 million.
The portfolio's objective was to actively support economic development in Namibia, Investec said in a statement.
Primus Hango, principal officer of the Fund, said a number of established and emerging companies were already being supported either through equity participation or straight loans by the portfolio.

These included Swabou, Namibia's largest Building Society, the National Housing Enterprise, two Stocks and Stocks Namibia hotels and the former Namib Building Society in which Boland Bank has a minority shareholding.
Investec Asset Management (IAM) Namibia's Maritjie van Zyl said the company's objective would be to provide as high a return as possible invested locally.
She said IAM Namibia would issue invitations to Namibian entrepreneurs and established companies in the near future to submit investment proposals for possible funding by the Investec.
